summary: Short, steep kerb on a residential street with homes about 15 m away.
reasons: Dwellings 15 m away on same side
Cars park on opposite kerb only

best_section.where: East kerb of Baty Street beside the kindergarten, under tree canopy

drivers.seclusion: Kindergarten 14 m away and dwellings 15 m on the same side; bush opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; east kerb is clear, with the parked cars on the west side.
drivers.traffic: Local street near the kindergarten; some drop-off traffic in the day.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the west kerb, not the east; No Stopping 8am-4pm weekdays here, so overnight is outside it.

flags: No Stopping signs 8am-4pm Mon-Fri on this kerb
Only 16 m of kerb, barely over one van length
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by trees over the east kerb; some afternoon sun through the canopy.
